title: thymus membranaceus var. funkii
intro: Thymus membranaceus var. funkii, commonly known as Spanish thyme, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Spanish thyme include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve respiratory issues, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Spanish thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and linalool, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
